_readme: Global game values. Edit, save, then press T in the running game (or restart it). Keys starting with _ are notes. Leave a key out to use its default from scripts/core/tuning.gd.

rules._notes: Changing these changes every puzzle. Re-check the levels after a change: python3 tools/sim.py levels/*.json

loop._notes: How cubes move. Speed is along the belt in screen pixels (the screen is 1080 wide). Lap time is clamped so small and large loops both feel right.

feedback._notes: The tray wobble when a tap can't send anything (no free cups).

solver._notes: Dead-end check after each move. When a budget runs out the game says the solver gave up instead of calling a dead end.

look._notes: Sizes in screen pixels; colors as hex. Cube size must stay under 76 (the tray cavity).
